raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE SUMMARY
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified (KPMG Sponsored) professional with 10+ years driving Process Excellence, PMO, and Digital Transformation across GCC, NBFC, and Heavy Manufacturing sectors. Proven track record of delivering USD 1.5M+ in annual savings through RPA-UiPath automation, DMAIC- led project execution, VSM, and Kaizen-based continuous improvement. Adept at leveraging Power BI, SQL, and AI-powered tools for real-time governance and data-driven decision-making across cross-functional GCC, US, and India-based teams.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS & INITIATIVES
AI-Powered Process Health Dashboard | Clean Harbors
Built a Power BI dashboard integrating RPA telemetry and SAP data for real-time process health scores across GCC departments. Reduced escalation response time by 40% and enabled proactive SLA management. Tech: Power BI, SAP, UiPath, SQL
Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) Automation | Mahindra Home Finance
Deployed enterprise IDP using UiPath + OCR to automate KYC and compliance verification. Achieved 100% regulatory compliance and cut manual verification by 70%. Impact: ₹1.5 Cr annual savings.
End-to-End Loan Process Digitization | Mahindra Home Finance
Drove full digital transformation of the loan lifecycle via RPA and workflow automation. Reduced TAT from 35 days → 7 days (80%), increased business volume by 14%, saving ₹2 Cr/year.
Enterprise Lean Transformation Roadmap | Clean Harbors GCC
Designed multi-year Lean Transformation roadmap across 5 business units integrating VSM, FMEA, and Kaizen events. Delivered 20% OE improvement in Year 1 with a CI governance framework.
VoC Analytics Framework | Mahindra Home Finance
Established a VoC framework using Google Analytics and NPS/CSAT data to prioritize product features. Resulted in 13.5% improvement in customer retention and 18% CSAT uplift.
CI Tracker Digitization: Excel → PowerApps | Clean Harbors
Led end-to-end digitization of CI tracker with real-time dashboards and automated alerts. Improved process visibility by 60%, reduced manual reporting by 5 hrs/week.

Mahindra Home Finance │ Hyderabad | Business Excellence Manager
Aug 2023 – Nov 2025
Transformed loan processing speed end-to-end delivering 80% TAT reduction (35 → 7 days) and ₹2 Cr saved annually, by applying DMAIC-led process redesign integrated with RPA-UiPath workflow automation
Eliminated non-value-adding steps across 5 departments driving process efficiency from 15% → 35%, by executing comprehensive VSM to surface and remove waste at each process stage
Achieved full KYC and compliance accuracy generating 100% regulatory compliance and ₹1.5 Cr in annual savings, by deploying Poka-

Yoke driven IDP automation using UiPath and OCR — cutting manual effort by 70% Improved complaint resolution across NHB, CPGRAMS, and NCH portals cutting closure TAT from 11.9 → 5 days (58% faster), by applying FMEA and Control Charts for proactive SLA monitoring and risk management
Strengthened customer loyalty and satisfaction scores contributing to 13.5% retention uplift and 18% CSAT improvement, by applying Pareto analysis and VoC (NPS/CSAT) insights to prioritize CRM product enhancements

Sep 2016 – Feb 2019
Maximized underground mining equipment reliability achieving 95%+ uptime and 20% reduction in unplanned downtime, by applying 5-Whys RCA for recurring failures and implementing structured preventive maintenance schedules
